'''Biomass''' is a [[Mobs|Mob]] / living projectile, it has no tier.

==''Spawning''==
*Summoned by all [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Beckon Stages]], [[Summoner (Disambiguation)|both Summoners]], and [[Overseer|Overseers]].

==''Behavior''==
Biomass is a utility parasite does not move or attack, its only function is to spawn mobs.

*Biomass pulsates and grows once touching the ground, spawning a mob based on the spawn pool of its summoner after 5 seconds.
**If the target of the summoner if three or more blocks above it, an Air type parasite will spawn. If else, a Ground type parasite will spawn.

===''Weaknesses''===
*Biomass, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], presents a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*Setting the summoner on fire tends to cause any biomass it spawns to be set on fire.
==''Sounds''==
TBA

==''Trivia''==
*Biomass varies in size and model depending on its summoner.

== ''Commands'' ==

* When summoning Biomass, you can include ''parasiteparasite:"(mob id here)"''  in the entity data to dictate what it summons. Having ''Fuse:(number, in ticks)s'' is also necessary in order to dictate how long the Biomass will exist before it spawns what's in the biomass. For example, the command /''summon srparasites:biomass ~ ~ ~ {parasiteparasite:"srparasites:anc_overlord",Fuse:100s}'' will summon Biomass that spawns an Ancient Overlord after 5 seconds.
**Including parasitetype:{1, 2, 3} will change the model used by the biomass.
